div.head: II Cn 17
div.ab: [And ne gesece nan man þone] cingc, butan he ne mote beon nanes rihtes wyrðe innan his hundrede.
And ne gesece nan man þonne cyningce, buton he ne mote beon nanes rihtes wirðe innan his hundrede.
Nemo regem requirat de iusticia facienda, dum ei rectum offertur in hundreto suo.
Ne geséce nan man ðonne cyng, buton he ne mote beon nanes rihtes wurðe innan his hundrede.
And ne gesece nan man ðone cingc butan he ne mote beon nanes rihtes wyrðe innan his hundrede.
Und niemand gehe den König an, ausser wenn er innerhalb seiner Hundertschaft [seines] Rechtes nicht theilhaftig werden kann.
And let no one apply to the king, unless he cannot obtain [his] rights within his hundred.
And no-one shall appeal to the king, unless he fails to obtain justice within his hundred.
And no one may petition the king unless he cannot obtain his rights within his hundred.
